title: WeeklyProjection
description: One player's next game as a distribution, from `weekly-startsit-v1` (ADR-096; contract 1.1 adds `explanation`, ADR-099): seven quantiles of fantasy points in the row's scoring preset, GIVEN THAT HE PLAYS, for the game in `target_week`. A decision-layer model: it reads the rest-of-season snapshot's point-in-time features plus the game's sportsbook environment and the opponent's allowed points, and no intrinsic model reads it. The injury block is the league's official report printed beside the projection; the model never reads it. One record per player and scoring preset; league size changes nothing here, only the startable threshold the page compares against (published in `ros_build_metadata.weekly`).

account.description: One quantile explained against his typical week (`typical_week_shapley_v1`): `typical` + every term + `calibration` + `rearrangement` equals the published quantile, exactly, at two decimals.

typical.description: The same quantile in his typical week: everything about him held at this week's values, in a weighted set of ordinary games for him (his team's mean posted lines over its completed games, shrunk toward the league by three games; half at home; his team's indoor share; equal rest; a league-average defence at this cutoff). Pregame only.

terms.description: Exact weighted Shapley values of each game-specific input group over the reference games: how far this model's quantile moved with that input, the others held. A model attribution, not a measured causal effect.

lines.description: The sportsbook total, his team's side of the spread and its implied points.

home.description: Home or away; a neutral site reads as away.

rest.description: His team's days of rest against the opponent's.

roof.description: Indoors or not, as v1 reads it: an unannounced retractable roof takes the stadium's state at its latest earlier home game (weekly_context says when).

opponent.description: The opposing defence's allowed points to his position, against a league-average defence.

calibration.description: The split-conformal shift is the same constant this week and in his typical week, so it explains none of the difference; published so the account visibly includes it.

rearrangement.description: What the monotone repair moved in either reading, plus rounding to two decimals. It closes the account.

through_week.description: The snapshot cutoff: weeks 1..through_week are the only in-season evidence.

target_week.description: The week being projected: always through_week + 1.

game_state.description: `upcoming`: the game had not kicked off when the build ran. `kicked_off`: it had (a Thursday game read on Friday) and the projection is kept for the record, not for a decision. `bye`: his team has no game in target_week; `game`, `quantiles`, `drivers` and `opponent` are null. `lines_pending`: the game exists but its sportsbook total or spread is not posted, and the model was never trained without them, so `game` and `opponent` are published and `quantiles` and `drivers` are null (ADR-096).

total_line.description: Sportsbook game total, from nflverse's schedule. A MODEL INPUT for this model (ADR-096), and for no other.

team_margin.description: The spread from this team's side: positive means favoured by that many.

team_points.description: (total + margin) / 2: the sportsbook's implied score for his team.

quantiles.description: Fantasy points in this preset, given an appearance. Monotone by construction; `quantile_distribution_v1` (in the build metadata) says how a page turns them into a distribution.

drivers.description: An additive account of q50: the median booster's expected value (`baseline`), grouped TreeSHAP contributions per feature family, the conformal shift (`calibration`) and whatever the monotone repair and rounding moved (`rearrangement`). The ten numbers sum to q50.

explanation.description: Why this week differs from his typical week, at the floor (P10), the median and the ceiling (P90). Null exactly when `quantiles` is null.

opponent.description: Fantasy points the opposing defence has allowed to this position per game through the cutoff, shrunk toward the league rate by four games (`weekly_game_context_v1`). `rank` 1 is the most generous defence.

injury.description: The league's official report for target_week as nflverse publishes it, or null when he is not on it. Printed beside the projection; never read by the model.
